schema: Design5 PurcellReadout inputs, revision r2 (2026-11-19): r1 inputs + tee placement chosen to avoid the C_in standing-wave nodes.

hammer.target: same hammer as Design6 (J ~ 13-15 MHz over 6.0-7.0 GHz, closed form)

cp_cap.source: Design4/layout/purcell_6500.py ENC_CAI (C_p and C_in, as chip6_d4.py)

loads.status: estimates: C_p Design4 cp coupon (16/9, eps 11.5); cj / head_excess / open_end None = model fits; replaced by Design5 Q3D

cp.reason: kappa_p at x = +0.76 mm was 0.81 x hanger in the full-feed model; C_p 40.10 -> 44.75 fF restores 1.0 x (kappa ~ C_p^2)
full-feed circuit model gave kappa_p 0.83 x hanger at x = -3.39 mm; C_p 40.10 -> 44.03 fF

placement_method.rule: skill/purcell_resonator_design.md section "Feed with a series C_in"
placement_method.model: circuit model of the full feed (Q3D C_in / C_p pi networks, all channels), v = 1.2e8 m/s
placement_method.objective: maximise the worst kappa_p / kappa_hanger over f x (0.99, 1, 1.01), v x (0.98, 1.02), C_frame x (0.8, 1.2), C_in x (0.9, 1.1)
placement_method.constraints: same-side tee pitch >= 1.7 mm (tall meanders), opposite-side >= 0.6 mm, x in [-3.40, 3.55] mm

cp_compensation.rule: C_p,new = C_p sqrt(kappa_target / kappa_model) for channels with ratio < 1 (raise only); kappa_target = hanger value with C_p 40.10 fF
cp_compensation.check: full circuit model (S21 + s21_channel fit) after each change
